newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal rallies after Cheuvreux upgrade.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal rallies after Cheuvreux upgrade.

text.p: Shares in cosmetics group L'Oreal outperformed a rising market on Wednesday, rallying 4.08 percent to 1,992 francs at midday, after brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu raised its rating to buy from sell, fund managers said.
They said Cheuvreux also included L'Oreal's 57-percent owned Synthelabo pharmaceuticals subsidiary in its list of recommended shares, replacing Pinault-Printemps-Redoute.
Synthelabo shares were up 4.4 percent at 640 francs at 0955 GMT. The market's CAC-40 index was up 1.45 percent.

Synthelabo's stock rose more than two percent on Tuesday after its chairman told analysts the group would derive half of the profits of its Lorax venture with Searle by the year 2000, up from 10 percent currently.
It had risen 6.4 percent the previous day on speculation of a link-up with another drug firm as part of the pharmaceutical industry's consolidation.
Fund managers said Cheuvreux remains a buyer on Pinault-Printemps, whose stock was up 1.54 percent at 2,380 francs.
